notes.title: Celestial Project Continue Update and v2 Update Log
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648548/ac4e68bc2e96228afe808f002e25bfc6bf7fff9b.png

In the past year after its release, "Celestial Project " is still far from the full version. The development team has experienced some difficult choices, and the game has lost its update. We would like to apologize to all players.

However, "Celestial Project " will continue to update the content in the future. After the game realizes the original plan and has a high degree of completion, we will also develop a sequel to "Celestial Project" with RPG gameplay.

v2 Update Log

 The new game, settings and other menu UI support keyboard ↑↓←→ WASD ESC operation
 Some menu UI add interaction animation
 The producer presses the key to speed up the skip
 Some text bug fix


Subsequent version updates will be replaced by plain integers like v2 v3.

notes.title: Celestial Project Full Version Released and v0.2.1 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648548/ac4e68bc2e96228afe808f002e25bfc6bf7fff9b.png

We are very happy to tell you that the full version of "Celestial Project" will be released today. 10% off for the first week.

"Celestial Project" is the first PC game of KumaPaw Studio. The game combines Roguelike and war chess gameplay. It has a certain degree of strategic difficulty. We hope you can enjoy the game.

v0.2.1 update logs, including demo update

Add team description, including some worldview
Reduce the difficulty of some early levels
Experience boost is increased, therefore skills can be unlocked earlier
Growth chips add initial value
Some value balance adjustment
